provenance.inverseMethod: Known-component inverse rendering; no source separation was run.
provenance.renderer: Historical point_doppler_v2 numeric functions; CPU float32.
provenance.timeMapDescription: Instantaneous Doppler-rate integration anchored at source time zero. No absolute propagation delay.
provenance.geometricGainDescription: dopplerScale / distance only; excludes frequency-dependent air absorption and semantic camera mix gain.
provenance.worldUnits: Marble units provisionally treated as meters; not independently calibrated.
provenance.encoding: 48 kHz mono PCM16 with the same playbackGain on all three tracks; no per-track normalization.
provenance.scope: Ten-second real generated plane stem and its input-camera rendering. Excludes static/ambient sources and source separation.
